import cv2,numpy as np
c=cv2.VideoCapture('example_video.mp4')
fs=[]
while True:
  r,f=c.read()
  if not r: break
  fs.append(f)
for i in range(len(fs)):
  cv2.putText(fs[i],str(i),(10,30),0,1,(0,0,255),2)
rows=[np.hstack([cv2.resize(fs[i],(480,270)) for i in range(j,j+30,10)]) for j in range(0,120,30)]
cv2.imwrite('dbg/grid.jpg',np.vstack(rows))
"
